Ravi: Drafting release notes + internal announce for Friday change window (Fri 11:00 UTC). Short ask: owners for notes, canary, rollback steps, and announcement copy.

Ravi: Draft notes ->
- Fix: batching edge case that caused sporadic latency spikes
- Canary: 1% -> 5% over 45m with health checks at each step
- Rollback: pin to last-stable and cut traffic if errors > 3% for 4m

Tess: I'll take canary cadence + deploybot schedule. cc @deploy-bot for warmup slot.

deploy-bot: reserved warmup 2025-06-06T10:20Z. Command templates: `deploybot warmup --model rwinf-lite:3.1.1 --regions us-east,eu-west` and `deploybot canary start --steps 1,5 --pause 20m`.

Marta: I'll own rollback runbook and add exact `rwctl` pin commands + TL;DR for announce.

OncallLead: I'll draft internal announce (2 bullets + links) and schedule 24h preflight. Plan: Thu 11:00 UTC pre-alert, Fri 10:40 UTC go/no-go.

Ravi: Nice. Please post link to runbook when ready and drop a :thumbsup: here when complete.

Tess: :thumbsup: schedule confirmed.

Marta: :thumbsup: runbook link -> https://internal.redwood/docs/release/runbooks/2025-06-06-ops

OncallLead: Draft announce ->
- What: Runtime batching fix (reduces rare latency spikes)
- When: Fri 11:00 UTC (canary)
Link: https://internal.redwood/docs/releases/2025-06-06-draft
Please review for send on Thu 11:00 UTC.

Ravi: Approved from product. Closing loop 1 Thanks everyone, pinning thread for ops.
